import sys, json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def to_float(x):
    return round(float(x), 2)

def pct(x):
    return round(float(x), 1)

df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])

facts = []

# Totals
rev_tw_total = df['Revenue_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
rev_lw_total = df['Revenue_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
rev_ly_total = df['Revenue_LY'].sum(skipna=True)
units_tw_total = df['Units_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
units_lw_total = df['Units_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
orders_tw_total = df['Orders_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
orders_lw_total = df['Orders_LW'].sum(skipna=True)

facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"TW","value":to_float(rev_tw_total),
              "formula":"sum(Revenue_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"LW","value":to_float(rev_lw_total),
              "formula":"sum(Revenue_LW)"})
if not pd.isna(rev_ly_total) and df['Revenue_LY'].notna().any():
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"LY","value":to_float(rev_ly_total),
                  "formula":"sum(Revenue_LY)"})

if rev_lw_total and not pd.isna(rev_lw_total) and rev_lw_total != 0:
    wow_total = (rev_tw_total - rev_lw_total) / rev_lw_total * 100
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"WoW","value":pct(wow_total),
                  "formula":"(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100"})

if rev_ly_total and not pd.isna(rev_ly_total) and rev_ly_total != 0:
    yoy_total = (rev_tw_total - rev_ly_total) / rev_ly_total * 100
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"YoY","value":pct(yoy_total),
                  "formula":"(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100"})

facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"units","period":"TW","value":to_float(units_tw_total),
              "formula":"sum(Units_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"units","period":"LW","value":to_float(units_lw_total),
              "formula":"sum(Units_LW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"orders","period":"TW","value":to_float(orders_tw_total),
              "formula":"sum(Orders_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"orders","period":"LW","value":to_float(orders_lw_total),
              "formula":"sum(Orders_LW)"})

# Top entities by revenue TW (rank)
top_rev = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue_TW']).sort_values('Revenue_TW', ascending=False).head(5)
for _, row in top_rev.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"TW","value":to_float(row['Revenue_TW']),
                  "formula":"Revenue_TW"})

# Share of top 3
top_share = df.dropna(subset=['Share_Pct']).sort_values('Share_Pct', ascending=False).head(3)
for _, row in top_share.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"share","period":"TW","value":pct(row['Share_Pct']),
                  "formula":"Share_Pct"})

# Rank 1 entity
rank1 = df[df['Rank'] == 1]
for _, row in rank1.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"rank","period":"TW","value":to_float(row['Rank']),
                  "formula":"Rank"})

# Top WoW gainers/decliners
wow_valid = df.dropna(subset=['WoW_Pct'])
top_wow_gain = wow_valid.sort_values('WoW_Pct', ascending=False).head(3)
for _, row in top_wow_gain.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"WoW","value":pct(row['WoW_Pct']),
                  "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100"})

top_wow_decline = wow_valid.sort_values('WoW_Pct', ascending=True).head(3)
for _, row in top_wow_decline.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"WoW","value":pct(row['WoW_Pct']),
                  "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100"})

# Top YoY gainers/decliners
yoy_valid = df.dropna(subset=['YoY_Pct'])
if not yoy_valid.empty:
    top_yoy_gain = yoy_valid.sort_values('YoY_Pct', ascending=False).head(3)
    for _, row in top_yoy_gain.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"YoY","value":pct(row['YoY_Pct']),
                      "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100"})

    top_yoy_decline = yoy_valid.sort_values('YoY_Pct', ascending=True).head(3)
    for _, row in top_yoy_decline.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"YoY","value":pct(row['YoY_Pct']),
                      "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100"})

# Trim to 25 facts max
facts = facts[:25]

print(json.dumps(facts))
